scope.mode: Configured AI_CPU/AIV; actual kernel path requires separate raw analysis
scope.rank_max: Max over sixteen ranks for each of thirty aligned samples, then quantiles
scope.one_call: Isolated eager call or one-node graph replay, not bare network alpha
scope.156: Same-buffer dependent chain; total/156 is batch average, not per-call tails
scope.graph: Includes replay dispatch, rank skew and dependent sum scheduling
scope.eager: Device event chain includes host dispatch gaps
scope.profile: Two extra FP32/24576/156 replays after the last timing case, source-bound ordering; no profile sample in timing arrays
scope.excluded: Pre-sample synchronize and Gloo barrier; no decoder or TPOT measured
